versions.subject: Adding new sig to detect password on commandline
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image: C:\Windows\System32\net.exe
selection_special:
    - Image|re:
        - 'net.*use [a-zA-]\:\s+\\\\[^\s]+\s+\/USER:\s*[^\s]+\s+([^\s]+)'
condition: all of selection*

versions.subject: Update win_susp_net_use_password_plaintext.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image: C:\Windows\System32\net.exe
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'net'
        - ' use '
        - ':\\'
        - '/USER:* *'
filter:
    CommandLine|endswith: ' '
condition: all of selection* and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\net.exe" CommandLine="*net*" CommandLine="* use *" CommandLine="*:\\*" CommandLine="*/USER:* *" NOT CommandLine="* "

versions.subject: feat: multiple fixes and updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' use '
        - ':*\\'
        - '/USER:* *'
filter_empty:
    CommandLine|endswith: ' '
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") CommandLine="* use *" CommandLine="*:*\\*" CommandLine="*/USER:* *" NOT CommandLine="* "
